title: Seek knowledge even in China
ref: al-Bayhaqi, al-Madkhal (ed. ‘Awwama) 2/663: famous text, weak chains
translation_note: Bayhaqi: 'its text is famous but its chains are weak'. Say 'weak chains', never 'fake'. The second half (seeking knowledge is obligatory) has other routes: do not claim it is baseless.
yt_title: ‘Seek Knowledge Even in China’: Real Hadith?

title: Paradise at mothers' feet
lines: “Paradise lies at the feet of mothers.”
^The authentic text is about staying with her.
quote_en: Stay with her, for Paradise is beneath her feet.
translation_note: Said to Jahimah who asked about jihad. Grading from al-Albani in Sahih Sunan an-Nasa’i p.2/651.
yt_title: ‘Paradise Is at Mothers’ Feet’: The Real Wording
